title: DDS calculations prototype rate catalogue
description: The statutory figures for each tax year. `rates` declares which figures exist; every year gives a value for each one. The calculation spec refers to rates by key.

rates.description: Every rate a tax year must provide. Keys must be unique.

years.description: One entry per tax year. Tax years must be unique.

messageKey.description: A key in conf/messages and conf/messages.cy

key.description: How the calculation spec and each year's values refer to this rate, e.g. personalAllowance

label.description: The rate's name as used in a sentence, e.g. 'higher rate'

kind.description: amount: pounds, shown as £12,570. percentage: a fraction between 0 and 1, shown as 20%.

values.description: A value for every key in `rates`, and no others. Percentages must be at most 1.
